author: cellish
body:
So basically my brother got 2 minecraft accounts for bday present. One with the IGN Orzoz and one with the IGN IWALVG.
I know these names are really weird but you know, it's my brother and he's just 12.

Anyways, I know Posighdun isn't an Admin anymore but when he was I asked him if my brother could play with his accounts on this server without getting banned for ban evasion. Today, he went on Avicus and got imediatelly banned for ban evasion by the console. Im asking you to unban my brother as he wants to play on the server but is unable to becasue of that I am banned. 


Thanks!

-Sam
